neutral.anchor_measurement: assistant visual anatomical registration on native raster; approximate scene anchor rather than subpixel contact metrology
neutral.anchor_basis: Body reference is crown-to-feet; the projecting bill and side tail are outside the main-body width. Anchor is the projected midpoint of foot supports.
neutral.vertical_motion_policy: Consumer positions this anchor and designs movement; a static source does not claim any animation.

geometry_policy: Native pixels and adopted per-frame references retained. Atlas neutral coordinates are shifted only by the adopted crop origin.

taxonomy.verification_scope: Primary linked sources check the identity/selected diagnostic traits where listed; visual_traits are a concise original artistic brief, not a claim of exhaustive field-identification accuracy.
